title: Cut After 2 Months, Then $11.4 Billion
description:
Cut from a football team in 1995. Then his movies made 11.4 billion dollars.

Sources:
- Wikipedia: Dwayne Johnson: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dwayne_Johnson

From Wikipedia (Dwayne Johnson): undrafted in the 1995 NFL draft, he signed with the Calgary Stampeders and was cut two months into the season; he started wrestling in 1996; he was paid $5.5 million for his first leading role, The Scorpion King (2002), a Guinness World Record for an actor's first lead; Forbes named him the world's highest-paid actor in 2016; his films have grossed over $11.4 billion worldwide. Not financial advice.

#shorts #dwaynejohnson #movies #howtheymakemoney
loop: So next time a team cuts you, remember:
cta: Wrestling or movies? Comment your pick.

scenes.narration: Cut from a football team in 1995. Then his movies made 11.4 billion dollars.
But that's not his pay. It's his films' box office, worldwide.
So he tried wrestling instead. The crowd loved him.
His first lead movie role still paid 5.5 million. A world record.
Just years after that cut: the world's highest-paid actor.
